issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `print_newline`, but the solution defines a function named `print_nl` and the template does not provide a `print_newline` stub. This name mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about the required function name and leaves the template without the expected placeholder.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Either change the problem statement to request `print_nl` or (preferably) update the solution and template to use `print_newline`. Add a `print_newline` stub in helloWorld.asm in the template (e.g., a label `print_newline:` with a `ret`) and ensure the solution implements `print_newline` instead of `print_nl`.

issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing a function named `print_newline`, but the solution defines a label `print_nl`. This is the same conceptual entity (a routine to print a newline) referenced with two different identifiers, causing students to be uncertain which name to implement and to map the requirement to the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the solution label `print_nl` to `print_newline` so the solution matches the function name required by the problem statement (or alternatively, update the problem statement to request `print_nl` if that name is preferred).
